title: Ex 7.3 (⇐) · If a is even, then a³ + a² + a is even
prompt: Let $a$ be an integer. Exercise 7.3 says $a^3 + a^2 + a$ is even if and only if $a$ is even. This problem is one direction of that if-and-only-if: prove that if $a$ is even, then $a^3 + a^2 + a$ is even. Use direct proof. (The forward (⇒) direction is a separate problem.)
answer_format: A structured proof: let, case, expr and witness steps (notes optional). No final answer box.
hints: Write a = 2n with a let step.
8n³ + 4n² + 2n has a factor of 2 in every term.
solution: Suppose $a$ is even, so $a = 2n$ for some integer $n$.
Then $a^3 + a^2 + a = 8n^3 + 4n^2 + 2n = 2(4n^3 + 2n^2 + n)$, which is even. $\blacksquare$

reference.note: This exact exercise, restated in ProofLab's words. Uses if-and-only-if proof (Section 7.1): this is the converse (⇐) direction, by direct proof, with Definitions 4.1, 4.2 (even, odd).
